text:
Ava: quick heads-up — in the infra dashboard compact list the left-aligned action buttons (edit / copy / menu) are visually misaligned and focus halos get clipped at the bottom on small densities. spotted on iPad and desktop narrow windows.
Len: repro steps? which density token value?
Ava: density token set to 6 (compact) -> row height 34px. tab to edit icon and bottom of halo clipped.
Priya: likely similar pattern to other tables: icons are pixel-nudged with translateY(-1px) and the row uses overflow:hidden. that will clip any outer halo.
Mark: short-term fix idea: add a contained halo via box-shadow on the button so it doesn't need to escape the row. example: `button.icon:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--focus-halo,3px) rgba(15, 100, 210, 0.16); }`
Sam: agree. Also recommend tokenizing halo size by density: `--focus-halo-compact:2px`, `--focus-halo-default:3px`. keep compact smaller so it doesn't feel heavy.
Ava: another problem: when you click copy we show a global toast at top-right. on compact lists it's ambiguous which row copied. request: local micro-toast anchored to the action icon that fades quickly.
Len: local toast makes sense. Implementation notes: absolutely positioned inside the row, `pointer-events:none`, `role="status" aria-live="polite"`, 1.2s duration. ensure it never steals focus.
Priya: accessibility nit: current icon labels are generic (aria-label="copy"). we should include context: `aria-label={`Copy ${item.name} id`}` or use `aria-describedby` referencing the resource name cell. prefer aria-label for screen reader clarity.
Mark: copy text for micro-toast should be contextual too: "Copied <shortName> id" visually, but for screen readers include full id as visually-hidden text. keep toast copy concise.
Sam: one gotcha — absolute micro-toasts stacking if user quickly copies multiple rows. plan: if a micro-toast exists for a row, reset its timer instead of stacking a new element. also ensure global toasts still work for system-level messages.
Ava: UX tradeoff: changing box-shadow vs removing transforms. If we remove translate nudges we may need to alter padding, affecting vertical rhythm across many lists. prefer minimal change: box-shadow + aria-labels + micro-toast. we can revisit density token adjustments in a separate token MR.
Len: dev checklist: 1) add box-shadow focus for icon buttons (tokenized sizes) 2) generate contextual aria-labels on render 3) implement micro-toast component for row actions (absolute inside row) 4) add QA notes about not changing overflow rules now.
Priya: keyboard order check: after adding micro-toast ensure tab order remains action icons -> menu -> row selection. micro-toast must be non-focusable.
Mark: Figma request: please add a compact frame with halo sizes and micro-toast placement. I'll update the component spec with z-index guidance: `--z-row = 200`, `--z-toast-inline = 300`, `--z-toast-portal = 1000`.
Sam: testing matrix: compact/default/spacious, Chrome/Safari/Firefox, VoiceOver + NVDA, mobile breakpoints, rapid copy bursts to verify toast timer reset. include visual diffs in PR.
Ava: timeline? can we get a scoped PR by Thursday with the minimal changes (box-shadow + aria-labels + micro-toast)?
Len: I'll pair with Priya and push a draft branch today. will not change global tokens.
DesignBot: Task created DS-1408: compact list icon halo + contextual micro-toast. PR draft #2511.
Priya: will run screenreader flows once PR is up. also will check reduced-motion settings so micro-toast respects it (fade only).
Mark: small copy doc: use "Copied" visually, and `Copied <name> id` in sr-only text. avoid verbose labels for long names.
Ava: thanks all. ping here when the PR is ready for review. :sparkles:
